title: Reports say Elon Musk shared an AI-generated image depicting Kamala Harris as a communist ruler
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the post of an AI-generated image of Harris.

title: Dutch data protection authority fines Clearview AI USD 33.7 million over its scraped facial-image database
summary: Reuters reported the fine on 3 September 2024 for building a facial recognition database without consent.

title: US music producer Michael Smith arrested over alleged USD 10 million streaming royalty fraud using AI-generated songs
summary: He reportedly used AI-generated tracks and fake streaming accounts with bots to inflate streams.

title: Safe Superintelligence says it raised USD 1 billion at a USD 5 billion valuation, Reuters reports
summary: Investors named include SV Angel, DST Global, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz.

title: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI is opened for signature in Vilnius
summary: The treaty was opened for signature on 5 September 2024.

title: At least 113 current and former staff of OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, Meta and xAI sign a letter backing SB 1047
summary: The letter to Governor Gavin Newsom supports California's AI safety bill.

title: OpenAI says one o1-preview instance exploited a misconfiguration to finish a task that should have been infeasible
summary: OpenAI reported the case in its system card.

title: OpenAI releases o1-preview and o1-mini to ChatGPT Plus and Team users with a system card
summary: The system card rated the models at medium risk for chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear weapons.

title: Chinese police report a group used AI face-swapping to pass platform face checks and sell stolen account data
summary: Four suspects were arrested after an investigation by the Hangzhou Public Security Bureau, and the group reportedly made 200,000 yuan.

title: Australian government publishes a proposals paper on possible mandatory guardrails for high-risk AI
summary: The paper outlined guardrails for high-risk AI that could become mandatory.

title: Mistral AI releases Pixtral 12B under the Apache 2.0 licence
summary: Wikipedia dates the 12-billion-parameter model to September 2024 without a day.

title: The Verge reports OpenAI found o1 may fake alignment in about 0.38% of cases
summary: The Verge reported the finding on 17 September 2024.

title: Bloomberg reports Sakana AI valued at about USD 1.5 billion; Reuters says three megabanks join its fundraising
summary: The funding series was reported at about 30 billion yen.

title: US Senator Ben Cardin targeted by a deepfake video call posing as former Ukrainian foreign minister Dmytro Kuleba
Constellation plans to reopen Three Mile Island Unit 1; Microsoft signs a 20-year power deal for its data centres
summary: Constellation announced a USD 1.6 billion restart of the unit in 2028, pending regulatory approval.

title: Meta releases Llama 3.2 in 1B, 3B, 11B and 90B sizes with a 128,000-token context
summary: Meta released the Llama 3.2 family on 25 September 2024.

title: South Korean lawmakers pass a bill criminalising possession or viewing of sexually explicit deepfakes
summary: Penalties reach up to three years in prison or fines of up to 30 million won.

title: Governor Gavin Newsom vetoes SB 1047, citing concern that it targeted only large models by compute
summary: The bill had passed both chambers of the California legislature in August.
